title: The Memory Hierarchy
description: Predict what a memory access will cost: cache sizes and associativity, the translation path, prefetching, and the point where a huge page stops paying for itself.
author: Underlayer
completion_criteria: Read all 8 concepts, reproduce the 109 checks in courses/mem/assets/samples/crosscheck.py, and break the layout on purpose to make the one check that catches it fail by name

modules.title: What a Page and a Store Cost

concepts.title: Measure the Instrument, Then the Memory
concepts.description: The noise floor is the spread of the estimator, not of a run, and at 14% it decides that every number here is a ratio.

concepts.title: A Chase and a Sweep Are Different Questions
concepts.description: Over the same 64 MiB a random walk costs 132 ns a line and a sequential one costs 3.5, and the 38x is the prefetcher.

concepts.title: A Band, Not Four Numbers
concepts.description: From 1.6 ns to 150 ns in one table, a step within a factor of two of every size /sys reports, and a plateau five times wide.

concepts.title: A Number From /sys, a Number Measured
concepts.description: Eight ways means nine lines that share a set cannot coexist, and 576 bytes of working set cost L2 latency.

concepts.title: Translation, and the 512x a Huge Page Buys
concepts.description: Same lines, same footprint, same sets, one difference: how many pages. A cliff at 64 pages, and a claim that is withdrawn when the mapping does not collapse.

concepts.title: What a Store Costs
concepts.description: A store to a line you do not hold costs 2.4x a read, writing 4 bytes costs what writing 64 does, and a non-temporal store never allocates at all.

concepts.title: Two Threads, One Line
concepts.description: Nothing shared, 8 bytes apart or 64, and a factor of at least 60 -- with every run checked against core_id so the claim rests on two cores.

concepts.title: The Harness, and the Claim It Refuses to Make
concepts.description: 109 checks, none of which asserts a bare number, and one group whose assertions depend on a measurement the machine may not provide.
